name: Chicken Feed
desc: A handful of mixed grain. Chickens go wild for it.

name: Egg
desc: A fresh egg, still warm. Laid by a well-fed hen.

name: Feather
desc: A clean, sturdy feather. Someone with a snapped quill might want this.

name: Fish Bait
desc: A pot of wriggling bait. One pot covers one fishing trip.

name: Fishing Rod
desc: A well-balanced rod. With bait in hand, you can fish anywhere in the realm.

name: Tiddler
desc: A tiny fish, barely a mouthful. A cat would still be delighted.

name: Small Fish
desc: A modest catch. Good eating, or good trading.

name: Medium Fish
desc: A respectable fish. The fishmonger pays fairly for these.

name: Large Fish
desc: A serious catch. Heavy enough to make your arms ache.

name: Trophy Fish
desc: A magnificent specimen. Fishmongers' eyes light up at the sight.

name: Legendary Fish
desc: A fish out of legend. Sailors will sing about this one.

name: Fancy Hat
desc: Capital fashion at its finest. Somebody out there would love this.

name: Sturdy Boots
desc: Well-made walking boots. A blessing for anyone who works outdoors.

name: Poetry Book
desc: Archivist Quill's own verse. Objectively awful — yet somewhere, someone would treasure it.

name: Bones
desc: Meaty smokehouse leftovers. Any dog in the realm would do anything for these.

name: Lost Locket
desc: A weathered locket dug up by a delighted dog. Someone must miss this terribly.

name: Honey Cake
desc: Baker Otto's finest. Sweet enough to make a child's eyes go perfectly round.

name: Lavender Tonic
desc: Soothes aching joints and weary backs. Gravediggers swear by it.

name: Silk Ribbon
desc: Capital-spun silk. Just the token a young squire might want for a sweetheart.

name: Smoked Herring
desc: Keeps for weeks on the trail. Foragers and rangers buy them by the string.

name: Bog Salve
desc: Sister Nettle's marsh-herb ointment. Smiths prize it for burns.

name: Spice Pouch
desc: Rare spices from the Ravenwatch trade guild. Innkeepers pay well to liven a stew.

name: Catching Net
desc: A fine-meshed net from the Saltmere loft. Quick hands can catch butterflies by day and fireflies by night.

name: Spade
desc: A sturdy Gearford spade. Soft earth around the realm hides worms — and sometimes better.

name: Butterfly
desc: Caught gently in the net. The academy in the capital collects specimens.

name: Firefly
desc: A jar of living light, caught after dark. Someone in a gloomy town might treasure it.

name: Storm Lantern
desc: A chandler's storm lantern. Dark hollows around the realm only give up their secrets by its light.

name: Glowcap Mushroom
desc: A softly glowing mushroom from a night hollow. Hedge-witches prize a matched pair.

name: Moon Draught
desc: Morwen's brew of paired glowcaps. Grants deep, dreamless rest — even to those long past sleeping.

name: Gilded Compass
desc: Guild-certified and gimballed in gold. Lighthouse keepers would pay dearly for one.

name: Music Box
desc: A gilded music box from the Grand Market Hall. Its tune soothes even bathhouse patrons.

name: Feather Pillow
desc: Three feathers, down-stuffed and double-stitched by the Net Loft. Softness itself.

name: Harbour Bucket
desc: A stout harbour bucket. Rain barrels around the realm fill in wet weather.

name: Rainwater
desc: Pure rainwater, barrel-caught. Herbalists swear tinctures brewed with it work twice as well.

name: Honey
desc: Appleford apiary honey, comb-fresh. Bakers and cooks pay well for it.

name: Hearty Pie
desc: Cook Mabel's egg-and-honey pie. Best eaten hot; best of all in the snow.

name: Grave Moss
desc: Pale moss that only grows in deep fog. Alchemists prize it.

name: Wraith Tonic
desc: Sythe's fog-brewed tonic. Even bone-keepers pay well for it.

name: Pressed Flower
desc: A wildflower pressed flat between old pages, still faintly fragrant.

name: River Glass
desc: A shard of glass worn smooth and cloudy by years in the current.

name: Tin Whistle
desc: A dented little whistle. Still plays a clean note if you blow just right.

name: Wild Berries
desc: A handful of ripe berries, foraged straight from the bush.
